notes.title: ⚔️ Bug Fixes & New Dialogue!
notes.content:
📜 Hello warriors! 

First of all thank you SO much to everyone who’s been playing Legacy of Sin: Ill-Boding! Your feedback has been invaluable, and today we bring you a major update with some crucial fixes and a new twist in the story:

🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements

* 🈶 Asian subtitles (Japanese, Korean, Simplified & Traditional Chinese) now display correctly!

* ♾️ Endless wave bug is gone! Those missions that never ended? They now conclude properly.

* 🛡️ Persistent attack missions fixed — certain attack missions would never end and only disappeared after ending the turn. This is now working properly.

* 🧠 Improved enemy generation logic — get ready for more varied battles!

* 🏆 All achievements are now possible to unlock — including the ones related to upgrading all units!

* 🎭 New Dialogue with Sten (SPOILER): During the showdown with Sten, a new dialogue scene has been added to better reveal his motivations and deepen the story. Prepare for an emotional turn! 

I'm always listening to your feedback — feel free to reach out through our Discord: https://discord.gg/xJHfGaSX. If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a positive review 📝 — it helps a LOT with our launch and keeps the fire burning for future updates! 🔥

Thank you for being part of this journey. More to come soon! ❤️

notes.title: indie.io - Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’re thrilled to share some incredible news with you!

Absolute Power Game Studio is excited to announce a new publishing partnership with the amazing indie game publisher indie.io! Starting today, indie.io is the official publisher for our upcoming strategy and city-building game, Legacy of Sin: Ill-boding.

This is a huge step forward for our studio, and we hope it’s equally exciting for you, our players!

[h3]Why We Chose indie.io[/h3]
Working with a publisher like indie.io allows indie developers like us to focus on what we do best: creating games. Meanwhile, indie.io takes care of the behind-the-scenes work, from managing store pages and marketing campaigns to showcasing games at digital and live events.

We chose indie.io for several reasons:
[list]
[*] Their diverse and exciting portfolio of indie games aligns perfectly with our vision for Legacy of Sin: Ill-boding.
[*] They give us the creative freedom to bring our unique vision to life without compromise.
[*] They have a stellar reputation for helping indie games reach a broader audience of passionate players.
[/list]
[h3]About Legacy of Sin: Ill-boding[/h3]
Legacy of Sin: Ill-boding is a thrilling mix of strategy and city-building, where you lead your army, manage resources, and make decisions that shape the fate of your people. Inspired by our passion for combining immersive storytelling with engaging gameplay, we’ve been working hard to create a game that will challenge and delight players everywhere.

[h3]Check Out indie.io’s Library of Games[/h3]
Want to discover more amazing indie titles? Visit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]indie.io's Steam Publisher Page[/url] and explore their growing library of indie gems.

[h3]Stay Connected[/h3]
As we embark on this exciting journey with indie.io, we’d love for you to join us!
Wishlist Legacy of Sin: Ill-boding on Steam to stay updated on all the latest news.
[list]
[*] Join our Discord community to connect with fellow players and share your thoughts.
[*] Follow us on social media for announcements, updates, and sneak peeks!
[/list]
Thank you for your incredible support, and here’s to a bright future with indie.io! Together, we’re bringing Legacy of Sin: Ill-boding to life for players around the globe.

Happy gaming!
Absolute Power Game Studio
